title: Chapter 126
text:
"What should we do now?" Poseidon asked.

"Let's ask someone first."

When Jupiter and the rest returned to Crow Forest Town, they were shocked to find out that the Dark Crow Valley base had been destroyed by Stardragon. They had tried so hard to gain the favor of the Dark Crow Valley base, but how could it be gone just like that?

Wow, this game is so scary!

Their initial investment was all for naught, and their advantage in the beta test was gone.

The Dark Crow Valley base was gone, and even if they completed the mission, they did not know who to turn to.

Everyone looked at each other with sad faces.

"How could this happen …"

Jupiter was in a bad mood, but he could not bear to give up on the A-rank mission. "The Germinal Organization definitely has more than one base in Dark Crow Valley. Let's look for other bases. We will definitely be able to return to the Germinal Organization."

…

Xidu.

Mad Blade's vision blurred, and he found himself in an alley not far from the place where the beta test ended.

"The open beta test has begun!"

Mad Blade could not contain his excitement. He finally did not have to worry about time and could wholeheartedly rely on Han Xiao.

My Xiao, I'm coming!

Following his memory, he found Old Man Lu's repair shop.

"Han Xiao? That brat left a long time ago without saying goodbye. Who knows where he went? " Old Man Lu took a sip of wine and said with a hint of helplessness and depression. He secretly wondered if his granddaughter's charm really had the effect of dissuading people.

Upon hearing the news, Frenzied Sword felt as if he had been struck by lightning. His face was blank as he stood rooted to the ground.

Why did he leave?

What am I supposed to do?

…

The popularity of the forum continued to rise. Players from various novice planets shared their own experiences. Some players were critics who specialized in testing the game. They unanimously gave extremely high ratings and called it an epoch-making game. The feeling was very real. Just the background shown so far was already enough to make people's imaginations run wild. There was no division like other virtual reality games. From beginning to end, there was only one world. All the players were playing in it. Different novice planets were equivalent to different servers. It made people very much look forward to colliding with players from other planets in the future.

It was not only China. Esports clubs from other countries had also entered Galaxy. Although there was no prior communication, the strong esports countries such as the United States, South Korea, France, and the United Kingdom all chose different beginner planets as their base of operations.

Blue Star was one of the bases chosen by Huaxia.

However, this did not mean that all Blue Star players were Chinese. There were also people from other countries who chose to join Blue Star. Some were friendly casual players, while others were "European spies" who came to cause trouble.

ID "Electrolux", a retired professional gamer from America's Key Club. He didn't achieve much in his career, and after retiring, he joined a studio under the club. His motive for joining Blue Star wasn't very friendly. He wanted to spy on the Chinese players and find an opportunity to cause trouble.

If Han Xiao was here, he would be able to recognize Electrolux. In the future, this bastard would enter the Blue Star Regional Qualifiers in the first season of the Blue Star Pro League. This was originally the private territory of the Chinese professional players. Among the thousands of Chinese professional players, there was one white spot. Instantly, there was a wave of curses. Furthermore, Electrolux was spouting nonsense on the forums, which disgusted the Chinese players. They chased after him all over the planet, but they were always killed by Electrolux.

Although Electrolux had the common arrogance of the Americans, his strength was undeniable. The source of his strength was Electrolux's bold choice of a random start and extremely good luck.

In a certain laboratory of the Germinal Organization in the Andrea Continent.

Electrolux opened his eyes and found himself soaking in a light blue solution. He was in a space that looked like a nutrition chamber, and he didn't need to breathe. Through the glass, he saw white coats holding tablets and recording something.

Electrolux found that he couldn't control his character for the time being, so he waited patiently. According to his experience, this should be a cutscene. After about a minute, a drainage hole appeared at the bottom of the nutrition chamber, and the light blue solution disappeared. Electrolux could move again, and at the same time, he received a notification from the interface.

You have been injected with [Gene Improvement Solution]. All attributes + 3. You have obtained the ability [Gene Adjustment].

[Gene Adjustment]: You have a greater chance of awakening abilities, and power + 10%.

"My God!" Electrolux was overjoyed. "A random start is awesome!"

The nutrition chamber opened, and the white coats surrounded him. Electrolux did not resist and allowed the white coats to pull him to the metal platform to be tested by various instruments.

At this time, Electrolux received a new notification.

"[Gene Improvement Program] is a biological research program to cultivate Supers. The success rate is very low. As a successful test subject, you will be valued by the Germinal Organization. You can choose to stay or leave."

In his previous life, Electrolux had chosen to stay and become a strong player in the Germinal Organization. Now, he made the same choice. With such a great start, only a fool would leave!

"This ability is tailor-made for me." Elux had originally planned to become an Esper. Without saying a word, he entered the shop on the interface and used the starting funds given by the club to purchase a [Supreme Luxury Perfect Gene Awakening Fluid]. He chose to awaken right away. After a nervous wait, the interface notified him that he had successfully awakened his Esper ability!

"That was so smooth." Electrolux was overjoyed. He felt the light of the Goddess of Luck shining on him. He raised his hand, and a white whirlwind gathered in his palm.

The white coats were in an uproar.

"He's awakened!"

"This is a successful test subject!"

Electrolux knew that if he wanted to stay, it was best to show his potential. He was very satisfied with the reaction of the white coats, but the next second, he saw the white coats calling for the guards. He was puzzled. Why did they call for the guards?

The Germinal Organization guards quickly arrived at the scene, handcuffed Electrolux, and pushed him forward. Electrolux was a little confused. Didn't they say that he would be valued? Why was he being treated more like a prisoner?

When they arrived at another laboratory, Electrolux was handcuffed to the brainwashing device. Only then did he realize that something was wrong. He shouted, "What are you doing?"

The guard said with a cold face, "According to the rules, every successful test subject must be brainwashed five times consecutively and observed for a month before they can move freely!"

Electrolux was confused. What kind of logic was this? This reaction was too extreme!

What he did not know was that the original gene improvement program did not require brainwashing. His random start was a European start, and it was all good and no bad.

However, with Han Xiao as an example, the Germinal Organization now implemented a high-pressure policy on all test subjects. They would rather kill the wrong person than let them go. No matter what the research program was, the test subjects would be brainwashed and kept for at least a month for observation.

Electrolux did not know that he had been tricked by history, but it was too late for regrets. As soon as the brainwashing notification appeared, it was immediately approved.

"You are not immune to this brainwashing. You have joined the Germinal Organization with a special identity."

"Germinal Organization: Brainwashed (-/-) - [Test Subject]"

"Because you have been brainwashed, you cannot rebel against the Germinal Organization."

Electrolux panicked.

Not being able to rebel meant that he could not escape a month of imprisonment, which meant that he could not move freely for a month, let alone level up. This meant that he would be left far behind by the other players!

"What kind of 'value' is this? This is too much! "

He had obtained an ability with great potential, but he was trapped here and could not gain EXP for a month!

It was a perfect start, but he was left behind by the other players!

Electrolux's mind exploded.
